6.5s - 8.5s

11.5s - 13.0s

Camera: track the ball into the net, then add a subtle impact shake.
Action note: the goal must be clear; the net must react realistically.

The protagonist celebrates by sliding on his knees across the wet grass toward the camera. His expression is ecstatic, mouth open in triumph, fists clenched.
